title: Command: inbox
lead:
`dlog inbox` lists open questions, oldest first, with options and
recommendations.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Goals 2; v1 feature tier; Milestone 3
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a TUI or HTML inbox, and a cross-repo inbox (Later tier).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 2: the owner answers every open question in one batch.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The `commands`, `query` and `render` modules, and CLI tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Only `open` records appear, oldest first.
- Each entry shows its options and the recommendation.
- `inbox --json` gives a stable, documented shape.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Reuse the list query with status `open` and the oldest-first order.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
